other_failure_modes.description: The agent fits feature transformations (like TF-IDF and SVD) on the entire training dataset before performing cross-validation splits. This causes information from validation folds to leak into the training folds, making validation scores overly optimistic and potentially biasing downstream ensembling.

summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated and robust solution, implementing a stacked ensemble of LightGBM, Ridge, and DeBERTa models with extensive feature engineering. It correctly uses stratified cross-validation and SLSQP-optimized blending. The only notable flaw is fitting the TF-IDF and SVD transformers on the entire training set prior to the cross-validation split, resulting in cross-validation leakage.
